functions.name: hscParse
functions.role: The driver’s entry into the phase: reads the file, runs the lexer and parser, returns the parsed module.

functions.name: lexer
functions.role: The alex-generated lexer, and home of the layout algorithm that turns indentation into virtual braces.

functions.name: parseModuleNoHaddock
functions.role: The happy grammar’s entry production; GHC.Parser.parseModule is a thin wrapper around it.

functions.name: runPV
functions.role: Runs the disambiguation monad in which expression-versus-pattern ambiguity is resolved after the grammar.

functions.name: tcRnModule
functions.role: Drives renaming and typechecking together, one declaration group at a time.

functions.name: rnTopSrcDecls
functions.role: Renames the top-level declaration groups in dependency order.

functions.name: rnValBindsRHS
functions.role: Renames the right-hand sides of value bindings, collecting free variables as it goes.

functions.name: rnExpr
functions.role: One equation per expression form; where each RdrName becomes a Name.

functions.name: lookupOccRn
functions.role: The lookup itself: one occurrence, resolved against everything in scope.

functions.name: tcTopBinds
functions.role: Typechecks top-level bindings and decides what gets generalised.

functions.name: tcExpr
functions.role: One equation per expression form: constraint generation for terms.

functions.name: tcApp
functions.role: Applications, including the instantiation of polymorphic functions.

functions.name: simplifyTop
functions.role: Hands the collected WantedConstraints to the solver once the module has been walked.

functions.name: solveWanteds
functions.role: The solver loop: work list in, inert set maintained, residual constraints out.

functions.name: deSugar
functions.role: The phase entry: elaborated Haskell in, Core out.

functions.name: dsTopLHsBinds
functions.role: Top-level bindings, including the evidence bindings the solver left behind.

functions.name: dsExpr
functions.role: One equation per expression form, each returning plain Core.

functions.name: matchWrapper
functions.role: The pattern-match compiler: equations and guards become case trees.

functions.name: getCoreToDo
functions.role: Builds the list of passes the middle end will run at this optimisation level.

functions.name: simplifyPgm
functions.role: One simplifier run: local rewrites applied everywhere, to a fixed point or the iteration cap.

functions.name: occurAnalysePgm
functions.role: Answers how each binder is used; nearly every inlining decision consults it.

functions.name: dmdAnalProgram
functions.role: Demand analysis: which arguments are certain to be evaluated.

functions.name: wwTopBinds
functions.role: Worker/wrapper: turns demand information into unboxed workers.

functions.name: corePrepPgm
functions.role: Normalises Core to A-normal form so the translation to STG is total.

functions.name: coreToStg
functions.role: The translation itself; on the far side of it, a let is an allocation.

functions.name: unarise
functions.role: Flattens unboxed tuples and sums away before code generation.

functions.name: codeGen
functions.role: STG into C--, one closure at a time.

functions.name: cmmPipeline
functions.role: The C-- optimisation pipeline: stack layout and proc-point splitting.

functions.name: nativeCodeGen
functions.role: Instruction selection, register allocation, assembly out.
